title: NILS pipeline family (nils-family.yaml)
description: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Record 57 (P6): a family is one entry for the person and several pipelines behind it, with rules choosing the member per unit. The family document lies in a folder whose subfolders, named as the members are, each hold a member's pair of descriptor (nils.job.yml) and pack (nils-pack.yaml); each member is a pipeline of the catalog in its own right. The document holds the roles the members read, the goals (the goal, the `task` switch whose values are the family's tasks, and the family's other switches), the tasks with the unit level each runs at and the members it may route to, the family-level needs in the pack's shape (hard needs skip a unit in the family's words, soft needs travel as caveats) and the ordered routing rules, each `when` an expression of the pack's language over the unit's facts, the person's choices and two facts of the unit itself: `unit.visits` (the sessions a participant unit holds; 1 for a session) and `unit.same_protocol` (whether every visit's T1w shares base, dimension, vendor and field strength). The first rule that holds names the member; a unit no rule takes, or whose rule names a member the task does not run, is skipped in words. Every expression is parsed and type-checked at load; a member a task routes to must be a pipeline at the task's level, and a member may read only roles the family names. A reader keeps a key it does not know; a key this version names is checked.

expression.description: An expression of the pack's language over the facts of a unit, the goal and the switches, and `unit.visits`, `unit.same_protocol`

level.description: The unit the task runs over: a session, or a participant with every session of the person

members.description: The members a rule of this task may route to, each a pipeline at the task's level

pipeline.description: The member's name in the catalog, the descriptor's name in its folder beside the family

method.description: The method and tool version, for the person

route.description: The member the rule sends the unit to, one of `members`

name.description: The family's name, the catalog's one row

roles.description: The roles the members read, which the needs and rules may name

task.description: The family's tasks; the first is the default

tasks.description: One entry per value of goals.task
